purpose: Companies Stratasys wants to sell into, where a competitor may already have a foothold. This is a sales target list ordered by displacement difficulty, not a competitor roster.

segments.why_it_matters: A pre-qualified list of 19 companies actively building drones at production intent. Every one is a Stratasys prospect. Intelligence indicates HP is supporting 14 of them [validation-needed]. If true, HP is buying ecosystem position ahead of the advertising, and the ad scan alone would never have surfaced it.

accounts.account: EXAMPLE - one object per company as they surface
accounts.notes: evidence_type: sponsorship / equipment supply / co-marketing / named customer / case study. displacement_posture: Open (no incumbent), Contested (competitor present, not locked), Locked (equipment installed and validated).

segments.why_it_matters: Named in HP's own live creative, so competitor presence is confirmed, not inferred. Hardest to displace, but the most useful for understanding what HP promises and where it is vulnerable.

accounts.notes: 25% weight cut across 48 printed parts, per HP creative.
